in_marathi.name: Niyathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Loyal to Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niyathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niyata', meaning 'fixed, firm, permanent, or true'. Niyathi represents the embodiment of loyalty and dedication to the principles of Dharma.

in_bengali.name: Niyathi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Loyal to Dharma
in_bengali.long_meaning: Niyathi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niyata', meaning 'fixed, firm, permanent, or true'. Niyathi represents the embodiment of loyalty and dedication to the principles of Dharma.
